clause: The employee will be employed as a Software Engineer in the Information Technology department.
The employee's job title is Data Analyst and the employee will report to the Engineering Manager.
The company appoints the individual to the position of Project Coordinator at its Pune office.
The employee's primary duties include software development, testing, and technical documentation.
The place of employment shall be the employer's office located in Pune, Maharashtra.
The employee shall work 40 hours per week, from Monday to Friday.
Normal working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM with a one-hour lunch break.
The employee may be required to work overtime with prior approval from the manager.
The standard work schedule consists of five working days each week.
The employee shall follow the shift timings assigned by the company.
The employee shall receive a monthly salary of INR 50,000, payable at the end of each month.
The annual compensation package shall be INR 8,00,000, subject to applicable deductions.
The employee will be eligible for a performance bonus based on annual appraisal results.
The employer shall deduct income tax and other statutory contributions from the employee's salary.
Salary revisions may be considered during the annual compensation review.
The employee will receive medical insurance coverage under the company's group health plan.
The employee is entitled to 12 days of paid annual leave each calendar year.
The company shall provide meal vouchers and transportation assistance to eligible employees.
The employee may participate in the employer's retirement and provident fund benefit plans.
The employee shall be eligible for maternity, paternity, and other applicable leave benefits.
This offer is conditional upon satisfactory completion of a background verification.
Employment is subject to verification of educational certificates and prior employment records.
The candidate must provide valid identity and address proof before joining.
The employer may conduct reference checks with the candidate's previous employers.
The appointment is contingent on the candidate meeting all eligibility requirements.
Please sign and return this offer letter to confirm your acceptance of the terms.
I accept the employment offer and agree to the conditions stated in this agreement.
The employee and an authorized company representative shall sign this agreement.
This offer must be accepted in writing by 30 September 2026.
Either party may terminate the employment by providing 30 days' written notice.
The employer may terminate the agreement for material misconduct in accordance with applicable law.
During the probation period, either party may end employment with seven days' notice.
Upon resignation, the employee shall complete the applicable notice period.
The company may terminate employment if the employee repeatedly violates company policies.
The employee shall keep all confidential information and trade secrets strictly confidential.
The employee must not disclose proprietary business information to any unauthorized person.
Confidential documents and customer data may only be used for authorized business purposes.
The duty to protect confidential information continues after termination of employment.
The employee shall not share non-public technical or financial information outside the company.
